checks.message: SITE-001 is explicitly provisional, medium-confidence, and not an official boundary.
All three Key Areas are marked provisional and are not used as parcel or approval boundaries.
Concept land-use partition, design layers, and metrics retain traceable IDs and provenance.
All display artifacts are generated locally with no remote dependency or active network request.
Customers, sites, costs, approvals, procurement, and implementation are not claimed as facts; gates and falsification rules are explicit.
Chinese and English proposals use aligned 13-section structures, claims, metrics, evidence anchors, and figure positions.
